issue.title: fix stacked bars on logarithmic axes

repository.name: Chart.js
repository.description: Simple HTML5 Charts using the <canvas> tag

issue.body:
When a logarithmic scale is used for as the vertical axis of a stacked bar chart, the base value of 0 caused a problem. The solution is to add an item to the scale interface `getBaseValue` that gets the value in dataspace coordinates that corresponds to the pixel returned by `getBasePixel`. 

I added a test to cover this case.

Resolves #3585

issue.title: A better fix for stacked bar charts with log axes

repository.name: Chart.js
repository.description: Simple HTML5 Charts using the <canvas> tag

issue.body: Still resolves the original issue, #3585 while also fixing the issue identified for normal stacked charts when the Y axis has a user defined minimum value
